Each entry quotes its source: the archived department B.S. page (Phase A raw capture, 2026-11-09) and the owner decision of 2026-11-12. The department's new-sequence pages returned HTTP 403 to a plain GET; they stay evidence gaps until browser-saved captures are added.
An announced course absent from SOC gets a course row labelled as a department announcement (never a fabricated SOC record). Anything assumed beyond the sources carries needs_review.
